h1: Ghana e-Business visa from the UK
intro: Ghana's e-Business visa lets you apply online for meetings, conferences and short business trips, without sending your passport away. We complete your eVisa application, check your invitation and employer letters and keep you updated until it's approved.
eligibility: You are travelling for meetings, conferences or other business activities
You have an invitation from a company in Ghana
You have a letter from your UK employer and a yellow fever certificate

sections.heading: How the Ghana e-Business visa works
sections.text: Ghana launched its eVisa system in May 2026. Your application, documents and payment are all sent online, and the approved eVisa is emailed to you. You keep your passport, which helps if you travel often for work.

sections.heading: e-Business visa or business visa?
sections.text: The e-Business visa is usually the quicker option. If you'd prefer a visa in your passport, or your case doesn't fit the eVisa, we can apply for a [Ghana business visa](/ghana-business-visa/) through the High Commission instead.

sections.heading: Yellow fever certificate
sections.text: Ghana requires all arriving travellers to show a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate. Get vaccinated at least 10 days before you travel, at a registered yellow fever centre.

sections.heading: Ghana e-Business visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Ghana e-Business visa applications for travellers across the UK. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/ghana) for Ghana.

faqs.q: Do I need to send my passport for a Ghana e-Business visa?
faqs.a: No. Everything is done online. You'll just need a clear scan of your passport photo page.

faqs.q: How long does a Ghana e-Business visa take?
faqs.a: Complete applications are often decided within a few working days. Apply at least a couple of weeks before you travel to be safe.

faqs.q: Do I need a yellow fever certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. Ghana requires a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate for entry, and you'll need to upload it with your application.
